skill.name: skill-installer
skill.description: Guide Codex through listing curated skills and installing skills from public or private GitHub repositories.
skill.summary: List and install Codex skills from curated sources or GitHub paths.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The Markdown command examples and dotted GitHub paths are mostly scanner false positives. Real risks remain from network retrieval, writes into Codex skill storage, arbitrary third-party installation, and instructions permitting system-skill replacement.

remediation.issue: Third-party repositories can be installed directly into the active Codex skill directory.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation, display the source and pinned revision, and review all skill files before installation.

remediation.issue: The instructions permit overwriting preinstalled system skills when a user insists.
remediation.suggestion: Remove this exception and prohibit replacement of preinstalled system skills through this installer.

remediation.issue: Network downloads and destination writes are security-sensitive operations.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict trusted domains, validate destination paths, reject symlink escapes, and avoid exposing authentication tokens in output.

content.value_statement: Manual skill installation is inconsistent and easy to misconfigure. This skill guides Codex through listing curated options and installing skills from GitHub repositories.
actual_capabilities: Directs an agent to list curated skills and mark entries already installed.
Guides installation by curated skill name.
Accepts GitHub repository paths, tree URLs, revisions, destinations, and download methods.
Describes public downloads and git sparse-checkout fallback for authentication failures.
Supports multiple skill paths and optional private repository authentication.
limitations: The package contains only SKILL.md; the referenced helper scripts are not included.
Installation requires network access to GitHub.
Third-party skills are not automatically reviewed or verified for safety.
Existing destinations normally cause an abort, but the system-skill overwrite guidance creates a conflicting exception.

use_cases.title: Add a Curated Skill
use_cases.description: List available curated skills, identify installed entries, and install one selected skill.

use_cases.title: Install Team Repository Skills
use_cases.description: Install one or more skills from a team GitHub repository using explicit paths and a pinned revision.

use_cases.title: Test a Skill Revision
use_cases.description: Install a selected skill revision into a controlled destination for evaluation before wider use.

prompt_templates.title: List Curated Skills
prompt_templates.prompt: List the curated Codex skills. Mark which skills are already installed. Do not install anything yet.

prompt_templates.title: Install a Curated Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Install the curated skill named [skill name]. Show the source before installation and report the final destination.

prompt_templates.title: Install from a Public Repository
prompt_templates.prompt: Review and install the skill at [GitHub repository and path]. Pin revision [tag or commit]. Stop if the destination exists.

prompt_templates.title: Install Multiple Private Skills
prompt_templates.prompt: Review skills at [private repository paths]. Use existing Git credentials. Install approved paths only, without exposing tokens or overwriting existing skills.

output_examples.input: List curated skills without installing them.

output_examples.output: The selected skill was installed in the Codex skills directory. Restart Codex to load the new skill.

output_examples.input: Install a skill when the destination already exists.
output_examples.output: Installation stopped because the destination already exists. No existing files were changed.

best_practices: Review every third-party skill file before installation.
Pin a trusted tag or commit instead of using a moving branch.
Restart Codex after installation, then verify the new skill before regular use.
anti_patterns: Do not overwrite preinstalled system skills.
Do not install from an untrusted repository without reviewing its contents.
Do not place GitHub tokens in prompts, command arguments, logs, or responses.

faq.question: Can this skill list available curated skills?
faq.answer: Yes. It directs the agent to list curated skills and mark entries already installed.

faq.question: Can it install from private GitHub repositories?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions support existing Git credentials or optional GitHub token variables.

faq.question: Where are skills installed by default?
faq.answer: They are installed under CODEX_HOME/skills, which defaults to the hidden .codex/skills directory in the user home.

faq.question: Does it overwrite an existing destination?
faq.answer: The documented default is to abort when the destination exists. System-skill overwrite guidance should not be used.

faq.question: Are downloaded skills verified automatically?
faq.answer: No. Review the source, pin a revision, and verify every file before installation.

faq.question: Why must Codex restart after installation?
faq.answer: Codex must restart to discover and load newly installed skills.
